claims.claim: On June 30, 2021, the Supreme Court ruled in G.R. No. 226852 that a two-hectare parcel in Barangay Makiling, Calamba, Laguna, owned by Asia United Bank, was exempt from CARP coverage due to prior industrial zoning.
claims.episode_span: On June 30, 2021, the Philippine Supreme Court ruled in G.R. No. 226852 that a two-hectare parcel in Barangay Makiling, Calamba, Laguna, owned by Asia United Bank, qualified for exemption from the Comprehensive Agrarian Reform Program because a prior local zoning ordinance had reclassified it as industrial.
claims.supporting_quote: Prior to the effectivity of Republic Act No. 6657, a local government unit's reclassification of specific use of land, as ratified by the Housing and Land Use Regulatory Board, exempts such land from the coverage of the Comprehensive Agrarian Reform Program.

claims.claim: Republic Act No. 6657 set a five-hectare retention limit per landowner.
claims.episode_span: The 1988 law had set a five-hectare retention limit and ordered shares for tenants on large estates.
